description: Get the historical trend of institutional (13F) ownership for an exact stock or ETF listing across multiple quarters. Shows total shares, published position value, and filer count. Total Shares and Total Value count common-share positions only; put, call and principal rows are left out, since they are not shares held. The filer count includes every 13F filer reporting any position, options included. Share Chg (QoQ) is like-for-like: it compares only filers with an observed 13F in both quarters, and each quarter notes the filers and shares it excluded (largest named) and names prior holders whose book is under SEC confidential treatment, so missing filings and identity changes are not trades. Values normally use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can include zero when unavailable. While the newest quarter's filing window is open, non-ETF primary stocks use a provisional combined view; ETF listings remain exact and as-filed because carry-forward is filer-wide.

maxPeriods.description: Maximum number of quarterly periods to return (default: 8, clamped to 1-500)
